Typhoon Noul Makes Landfall in Southern China, Prompts Mass Evacuations

Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China, prompting authorities to evacuate over 340,000 people. The storm led to the cancellation of at least 150 flights in Hong Kong and suspension of public transport in southern China. China activated flood-control emergency measures and issued a red alert as the typhoon approached the coast.
